notes.title: Alpha Version Demo Deactivation & Future Plans
notes.notes:
Thank you to hundreds of players who tried the alpha version! 
Based on the feedback, I identified some common problems in the alpha version:
[olist]
 There is a disconnection between the story and the combat because they are separated. It is difficult to follow the story, and the combat does not feel immersive because of this.
 The game seems to have more story/text content rather than the combat. The combat sections feel sparse compared to the amount of text to read in the demo. Being a JRPG, although a lot of reading is to be expected, the pacing of the game feels a little bit awkward due to the issue mentioned above.
 Part of the fun of tactics game is your characters grow stronger after each battle and you can customize their abilities to suit your playstyle. However, this is unachievable because of the roguelike mechanics. There is no sense of character progression in combat because power-ups are reset every session, and there is little control over which power-ups you receive due to RNG.
[/olist]

Moving forward, I would like to address these issues and share what changes to expect in the final demo version planned for release around Q2 2024:
[olist]
 The story and combat will be seamlessly integrated, similar to other JRPG games. For those who are not interested in the story can still skip it and access it later through a different menu.
 There will be story battles and free battles. Story battles will use fixed map layouts and enemies tied to the story, while free battles will be procedurally generated, similar to the combat in the alpha version.
 This game will be a turn-based tactics JRPG at its core. Most of the roguelike mechanics will be removed. Upgrades will become permanent, allowing the players to select the upgrades they want instead of pick 1 out of 3 options style. 
 The final demo will have 2-4 hours of content (mostly combat related), and save files will carry over to the final game. 
[/olist]

Lastly, the current version will be deactivated and no longer available until the next version is ready.
Thank you!

notes.title: Alpha Version 0.3.1 Update
notes.notes:
0.3.1 Patch Log:

Fixes & Changes:

 Added confirmation before going to battle if there are upgrade materials left.
 Fixed bug when replacing rune, stats bonus from previous rune still applied.
 Fixed bug stacking runes with the same effect does not work properly.
 Fixed minor text inconsistencies in PT-BR language during story scene 1, 2 and 4.
 Tweaked the UI in the Graphics Menu to make it easier to distinguish between rows.
 Updated "Feedback" link in the title screen


QoL Updates: 

 Automatically select "Wait" action when there is no other action that can be done during battle.
 Automatically select the previously used skill during battle.


Balancing:

 Increased Esmeralda's guard stats from 1 → 2
 Improved Esmeralda's skill Windslash damage from 70 → 80, range from 2 → 3
 Reduced Giant Toad's attack damage from 120 → 90
 Reduced Gigantis's guard stats from 8 → 5

notes.title: Alpha Version (Demo) is Out!
notes.notes:
You can download the demo for the alpha version now!
This demo will be available for download until the end of February 2024.

The main purpose of this alpha version is to gain feedback regarding the combat mechanics and the quality of the translation. Some features, such as roguelike maps/stages, skill transformations, and character progression, are still not available in this version but will be added later around Q2 2024. However, you should be able to experience the combat mechanics and the story in this version. 

Please give it a try if you're interested.

Cheers,
-Monoclove

Download here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809390

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As this year comes to an end, I'd like to share a bit about the development of "Rebirth of Arcadia" and what to expect in 2024.

I've planned two demos for release in 2024. The first demo will focus on gathering player feedback regarding game balance, mechanics, and localization quality. The second demo will represent the final game.

Currently, the first demo version is being developed and tested. I'm aiming to release this version in January, most likely around the third or fourth week. The exact date will be announced later, once the demo is approved by Steam.

For those eager to try the game and provide feedback, stay tuned for the demo release!

Lastly, Happy holidays and a Happy New Year to everyone! See you next year!

-Monoclove
